iitb: Flight Mechanics of Aircrafts and Spacecrafts

course_used.iitb: Flight Mechanics of Aircrafts and Spacecrafts (AE 341)

subtopics.t: Coordinate systems: heliocentric, geocentric and perifocal
Time systems: sidereal, dynamic and atomic
Regression of nodes and rotation of apsides

where.title: Orbits in Three Dimensions
topics: Heliocentric, Geocentric, Right ascension-declination, Perifocal, Topocentric and Geographic coordinate systems, Time systems
Sidereal, Dynamic and Atomic times, Classical / Keplerian Orbital Elements, Kepler's Equation, Relation between eccentric and true anomalies, Orbital perturbations, Earth's oblateness and its effects
Regression of the line-of-nodes and Rotation of the line-of-apsides, Sun-synchronous and Molniya orbits

other_units.name: Two-Body Orbital Mechanics
subtopics: Orbit equation; angular momentum and energy constants
Conic sections: elliptic, parabolic and hyperbolic orbits
Geometrical properties and relations between orbit constants

other_units.name: Orbital Maneuvers
subtopics: In-plane orbit changes and height adjustment

other_units.name: Interplanetary and Ballistic Trajectories
subtopics: Interplanetary Hohmann transfers and rendezvous opportunities
Ballistic missile trajectory and free-flight range equation
Effect of launch site movement and Earth rotation

other_units.name: Launch Vehicle Dynamics and Staging
subtopics: Classification of launch vehicles and missiles
Forces and moments acting on a rocket
Inertial and non-inertial frames; coordinate transformation
Equations of motion for three-dimensional flight
Multi-staging of rockets and vehicle optimization
Stage separation systems and separation dynamics
Navigation, guidance and aerodynamic control systems

other_units.name: Launch Vehicle Systems and Testing
subtopics: Solid motors: grain design, ballistics and igniters
Liquid stages: thrust chamber, feed system, tanks, valves
Pogo, propellant slosh and engine gimbal systems
Space environment and selection of materials
Qualification and testing of rocket systems
